purpose: Teach: イノベーション/シリコンバレー/バックトラック/石原/青木/品川/乗り込ん/三木

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、イノベーションを部活に取り入れろ
lines.en: Riku, you should bring some real innovation into the club activities.
lines.style: Direct, pressing. Leans forward slightly. Not a suggestion — a challenge wrapped in friendly confidence. Holds his eye.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、将来シリコンバレー行きたいんだろ?桜
lines.en: Wait — you're the one who wants to end up in Silicon Valley someday, right Sakura?
lines.style: Turning it back on her. Quick, caught-off-guard tone that softens into genuine curiosity. Half-smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、バックトラックして問題解こうぜ
lines.en: Riku, come on — let's back up and actually solve this together.
lines.style: Gentle course-correction. Steady, almost patient. Not sarcastic this time — sincere underneath. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、石原先生の授業、面白いって言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were saying Ishihara-sensei's class was actually interesting the other day, weren't you?
lines.style: Quiet observation, like he's been holding onto this detail. Thoughtful pace. Not accusing — just noticing. Soft on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、青木先輩、優しいぜ
lines.en: Aoki-senpai is genuinely kind, you know.
lines.style: Simple statement of fact. Warm without performance. Slight pause before the word 'kind' — like he's choosing it carefully. Steady eye contact in the tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、品川のスケートリンク、行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went to that skate rink in Shinagawa with them, didn't you?
lines.style: Casual, almost offhand. But underneath: testing the water. Interested in where this is going. The tone of someone learning how to ask.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、相手チームに乗り込んだ勇気、すげえな
lines.en: That took real courage — walking into the other team's space like that.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, no irony. Slow, measured. Like he's saying something he's thought about. Lands firm on 'courage.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお祖父ちゃん、三木さんていうんだろ?桜
lines.en: Your grandfather's name is Miki, right?
lines.style: Quieter, more vulnerable. The question of someone getting closer. Hesitant before her name — testing if it's okay to ask. Genuinely wants to know.
